audience: recruiters and hiring teams managing candidates and job pipelines in CATS

useCases.title: Find a specific candidate
useCases.text: Search candidate records or apply field filters, then open the matching record for review.

useCases.title: Review a job’s pipeline
useCases.text: Inspect job details and the candidates linked to its pipeline, including their current stages.

useCases.title: Read candidate history
useCases.text: Review activity, tasks and attachment metadata for a chosen candidate without downloading files.

useCases.title: Create a follow-up task
useCases.text: After explicit confirmation, create a recruiting task with an assignee and due date. CATS may notify the assignee.

useCases.title: Record a human-selected stage
useCases.text: Apply a stage you have chosen after confirmation. The connector requests trigger suppression; independent account webhooks may still run.
